topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Well, there's no turning back now. I've been thinking 'bout this move for a long time, even before the oats started showing their heads this spring. I know the news sits heavy, like the damp before a storm. We've been through heaps, haven't we? From the day we sowed seeds in our youth to when the rains failed us and we nearly lost it all. But this land, it holds too many ails, too much toil. I hope you understand, for the sake of our friendship, that I seek a place where the earth is kind and the sun shines longer. I'll carry our bond with me, always, like a sturdy plow through rich soil. May the saints watch over you, friend, as you toil here without me.
